identity.title: Canny the Can and the Book of Time

win_system.notes:
WAYS TO WIN

 The specified requirements for a winning combination in the base game are also used during bonus features or free spins play unless otherwise stated. Each wager is eligible for all winning combinations unless otherwise stated.

 You win if matching symbols appear along one of the following predefined lines on adjacent reels from left to right, starting with the leftmost reel. The number of possible lines in this game is 20. Please consult the paytable for the number of each symbol

wilds.name: It's a Classic!
wilds.behavior:
This feature is triggered by landing 3, 4 or 5 Book scatter symbols in the base game. When the feature is activated, 1 or more symbols are selected as the special symbol for the duration of the feature.

 Landing 3 Book symbols awards 10 free spins and 1 special symbol.
Landing 4 Book symbols awards 15 free spins and 2 special symbols.
Landing 5 Book symbols awards 20 free spins and 3 special symbols.

 Only Low or High paying symbols can be selected as special symbols. The Book symbol cannot be selected. Selected symbols are displayed with a golden frame and color change. See paytable for illustration.

 If the special symbols land anywhere on at least 3 reels they will spread to cover the reels that they landed on after all normal wins are awarded. After spreading, special symbols pay anywhere and can form paylines even if there are other symbols between them. If more than one special symbol lands on 3 reels during the same spin, they spread and create wins one at a time. The Book symbol does not count as a Wild symbol during this stage and cannot be a part of special symbol paylines that pay anywhere.

 Landing 3 Book symbols during the feature awards 5 extra spins and selects 1 additional special symbol. This can occur only until the special symbol bar above the grid is filled, after which no further retriggers are awarded.

wilds.name: What Time Is It?
wilds.behavior:
Land three Clock Man scatter symbols in the base game to trigger this feature, which awards 10 free spins!

 Clocks above reels 2, 3 and 4 show a new time on each spin.

 When a Clock Activator scatter symbol lands on reels 2, 3 or 4, wild Multiplier Clock symbols spread from the top of the reel and replace all symbols from the top to the Clock Activator symbol. The value of the wild multipliers on each reel will be determined by the time shown on the clock at the top of that reel!

 If more than one Multiplier Clock is part of a winning line, their multiplier values are first added together and then applied to the win.

 Multiplier Clocks can have the following values: WILD, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x, 10x, 11x, 12x

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS

 The Book symbol is wild and substitutes for all paying symbols.
The Book symbol does not appear in the What Time Is It? game mode.
The Clock Man symbol only appears in the base game.
